patterns: APPSC tests current tech launches (indigenous IP/MPLS router, Bengaluru 2024) and fastest medium = optical fibre (2025).
Other PSCs ask scheme purpose (PM-WANI = public Wi-Fi), Speed Post year 1986, India's largest postal network.
Physics angle: optical fibre works on total internal reflection.
Regulator vs broadcaster (TRAI vs Prasar Bharati) and PIN/MNP dates are the classic traps.
App is broad and sound; it adds many 2025-26 AP FiberNet/BharatNet figures that PYQs do not reach.
